title: It's Okay
about: Episode 12, the user's own two pictures brought to life with image-to-video (the painted figure on the beach, the night balloon). The twist on the series: a good AI does not make you smile, it lets you feel. Smiley balloons drift in, the robot holds a laughing mask over their face, the mask ends up discarded in the sand, and the night balloon's little figure floats up. Takes in its-okay-takes.json. The user's images live in out/inputs (not committed). v2: the finale is the same figure dancing inside the balloon, which joins the two halves.

scenes.prompt: the painted person sits on the beach hugging their knees, head bowed, the wind gently moving their wild hair and jacket, waves rolling in behind, the bold painted colours shimmer softly, slow push-in
bright yellow smiley-face balloons slowly drift down from the sky and bob in the air all around the sitting painted person, who keeps their head bowed and does not look up, waves rolling in

a small round white robot with one large glowing blue eye and thin silver arms rises up into view beside the sitting painted person and holds out a bright yellow smiley-face mask toward them, the person keeps their head bowed, painted style, waves behind

a small round white robot with one large glowing blue eye and thin silver arms sits quietly on the sand beside the painted person, a bright yellow smiley-face mask lying on the sand between them, the sky slowly turning to warm sunset colours, calm waves

the colourful painted figure projected inside the glowing balloon rises to their feet and dances joyfully, arms raised, spinning and swaying freely among the twinkling projected stars, the balloon glows and its colours bloom, the blue lights on the ground pulse softly, magical night
scenes.say: We only get to teach it once.
scenes.note: v2 after the user's note that beach and balloon felt like two videos: the painted figure cut out (rembg) and composited into the balloon's projection (out/inputs/balloon-figure.png), then animated dancing; take 3 of 3 (1 and 2 put real people in front).
